nothingToBookmark.title: Nothing to bookmark
nothingToBookmark.message: This page cannot be kept as a link. Only ordinary web pages can - not the browser's own pages, and not the new tab page.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tabilinks
welcome.message: Tabilinks lives on your new tab page - that is where your links, groups and workspaces are, and where you set it up. This button saves the page you are on into it.
